summary:

description.en:
Lumos NIX is Lumos Robotics' compact AI humanoid family, aimed at interaction, companionship and performance. Its smaller bipedal form provides a platform for expressive movement and coordinated voice-and-motion experiences in public-facing and educational settings.

The current NIX S3 product page describes an approximately 89 cm robot with 21 degrees of freedom, an RGB camera, microphones and wireless connectivity. Professional and Education editions offer different development and performance options. Those figures describe the S3 configuration; earlier NIX robots and other editions should be checked against their own specifications.
